name: scan

sections.heading: Origin and explicit import
sections.text: Implicit origin: PRELUDE. Original module: std.console. Explicit alternative: import "std.console" { scan; }.explicit; --no-prelude removes implicit visibility. Import every referenced prelude name explicitly; imports grant no capability.

sections.heading: Behavior, methods and protocols
sections.text: Mock input yields the parsed value deterministically. Input domain, cancellation, bounds, Unicode units and redaction remain part of the chosen plan.

sections.heading: Ownership and effects
sections.text: Reading input is an explicit effect. Mock execution does not attest a physical input device or a live window.

sections.heading: Errors and limits
sections.text: Invalid plans and incompatible output domains reject. Explicit std.console imports are required with --no-prelude; scan does not become available through a name in a comment.
